description: This file declares functions related to data image initialization and creation in the Cuttlefish project, including functions for initializing data, ESP, and miscellaneous images, as well as creating a blank image. It includes references to project-specific config classes and utility result handling.

classes.name: CuttlefishConfig
classes.description: Namespace containing configuration classes, including InstanceSpecific and CuttlefishConfig.

methods.name: InitializeDataImage
methods.description: Initializes a data image based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: InitializeEspImage
methods.description: Initializes an ESP image based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: CreateBlankImage
methods.description: Creates a blank image with specified size and format.

methods.name: InitializeMiscImage
methods.description: Initializes miscellaneous images based on the provided configuration.
